attributes.probed_form:
BASELINE remeasured live on a clean tree, reproduces v1 to the digit: real 149, insns T190/O191, multiset 7t, 11 ops clusters, fuzzy 91.80.

STEP 1 - v1's banked hypothesis REFUTED WITHOUT A BUILD, from target evidence. v1 said: 'give `big` a second reaching definition that the optimizer cannot prove equal, so `big - 23992` stops being loop-invariant'. `fnasm game/sys/memcard writeGauntletSave | grep r31` returns EXACTLY TWO LINES: `9c: lis r31,1` and `1b4: addic. r6,r31,-23992`. The target's `big` therefore has ONE definition and ONE use - the same single-def/single-use shape our build has - and still does not fold. A second reaching definition would additionally require a second `lis rX,1` that the target's 190 instructions do not contain. The hypothesis is refuted as stated, and the free `grep` that refutes it costs nothing next to the build it would have consumed.

P1 (REVERTED, NEUTRAL-REARRANGED): `u32 count;` -> `s32 count;` PLUS the subtraction split off into its own statement, `count = big - 23992;` -> `count = big;` / `count -= 23992;`. real 149 -> 149, insns T190/O191, multiset 7t; the only movement was `ours-only -1 cmplwi` -> `-1 cmpwi`, i.e. condition 1 alone, exactly as the law predicts. The HOIST SURVIVED (`addi r25,r6,-23992` still at O@a0). Splitting the expression into two statements does NOT reach the fold - a second, independent confirmation of v1's W1 finding by a different spelling.

P2 (REVERTED, NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL - object bytes unchanged): scoped `#pragma opt_loop_invariants off` immediately above `int writeGauntletSave(void)`, s32 retype held live. MWCC 1.2.5 emitted no warning and produced byte-identical output. This matters because the hoist IS structurally a loop-invariant hoist (proved below) and `opt_loop_invariants` is the named MWCC pragma for exactly that pass - so the natural instrument is INERT here, just as v1's D3c found `opt_lifetimes off` to be the wrong instrument on the sibling. Do not respell either pragma on this class.

P4 (REVERTED, NEUTRAL - identical 4t signature, hoist survived): move `big = 0x10000;` from just above `retry:` down to the statement immediately before `count = big - 23992;`, i.e. assign at the POINT OF USE. Motivated by the in-function precedent that local `zero` survives to a register and is consumed by `xor r0,r4,r23` rather than being folded. real 184 -> 184 with the switch live, signature unchanged. Assignment position does not reach the fold either.

P3 (REVERTED after fuzzy arbitration, and the substantive result of this run): ONE-CASE SWITCH as the unfused-branch producer at the mount guard. `if (cardWaitResult() != 0) { goto mount_fail; } CARDGetSerialNo(0, serial); goto mount_cont; mount_fail: return 0; mount_cont:` -> `switch (cardWaitResult()) { case 0: CARDGetSerialNo(0, serial); break; default: return 0; }`. MEASURED: real 149 -> 184, insns T190/O192, multiset 7t -> 4t, FRESH fuzzy 91.80 -> 91.3579. The branch-pair cluster DISAPPEARED and `fnasm 0xd8:0x114 --diff` shows the whole region e0..104 reproducing the target instruction-for-instruction (`cmpwi` / `beq ->+8` / `b` / `li` / `addi` / `bl` / `b` / `li` / `b`), opcode-identical with only register names differing. REVERTED anyway, because fuzzy, real and count-distance all regressed and the Mandatory-policy bar for accepting a non-exact change requires the function's score to objectively IMPROVE.
attributes.residual:
BEST RETAINED: UNCHANGED at real 149, insns T190/O191, multiset 7t. No source change kept; tree byte-identical to HEAD.

THE VERIFIED PRODUCER, and why it does not yet pay. The one-case switch is now a MEASURED-CORRECT carrier for this site: it is the only form of the five tried across two runs (goto pair, if/else, arm-swap, ternary, switch) that reproduces the target's `beq ->+8 / b` terminator, and it does so exactly. It costs +1 instruction because the TARGET HAS THAT INSTRUCTION - our old fused `bne` form was short by one word in a region that is now provably right. The reason the switch still loses on score is that the function is +2 elsewhere, and this run derives that +2 completely, by hand, from the aligned view:
  (i) +1 the constant-fold hoist: target `lis r31,1` alone at 0x9c (one word, r31 live across the retry loop); ours `lis r6,1` at 0x90 AND `addi r25,r6,-23992` at 0xa0 (two words). MWCC folds `big - 23992` into the canonical two-instruction materialization of the literal 0xA248 (ha16=1, lo16=-23992), which is precisely `lis 1` + `addi -23992`.
  (ii) +1 an extra live-zero materialization in the SECOND retry arm at O@290-294: the target emits ONE `li r25,0` and uses r25 for both the `stw` into lbl_80344A24 and the later `clrlwi. r0,r25,24` test, whereas ours emits `li r3,0` for the store AND `li r26,0` for the flag - a split web.
With the branch region correct, closing (i) and (ii) is the whole remaining count gap: 192 -> 190.

RECLASSIFICATION, and it is the useful half of this run. The two `ours-only -2 li` tokens are NOT an open source problem. Site one (T@170) is the target COPYING the live zero, `addi r26,r23,0`, where we rematerialize it as `li r27,0`; site two is the split web above. Both are the live-zero copy-vs-remat family, which claim.law.live-zero-copy-vs-remat-is-allocator-not-source.20260831.v1 states has no source lever - and which is already the stated basis of this TU's own MemCardCreateGaunt webfrank pin, closed there by the equivalent_copy_form stage. So this function's residual is now: ONE genuine source-class mechanism (the constant-fold hoist, seven axes dead), TWO allocator-class copies covered by an accepted law, and one `stw` schedule row at @24-34.

WHY THE HOIST IS LICM AND WHY THAT DOES NOT HELP: the retry backedge is `bne ->a0` at both 0x184 and 0x2a8 in the target and `bne ->a4` in ours, so both builds have the identical loop; the target's `lis r31,1` sits one word BEFORE the loop entry and its `addic.` INSIDE, while ours puts the subtraction in the preheader. That is a loop-invariant hoist by construction - and P2 shows the pragma that governs that pass does not reach it, because the value being hoisted is a compile-time CONSTANT and is placed by constant materialization, not by the LICM pass.

DO-NOT-RETRY on the fold, seven axes: subtraction into the for-init (v1 W1); branch-shape respell (v1 W2); sink the definition below the loop-back label (v1 W4, and twice-measured with the sibling's D3b); block-scope the counter (v1 W5); split the subtraction into its own statement (P1); scoped opt_loop_invariants off (P2, NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL); assign `big` at the point of use (P4). Also refuted: the second-reaching-definition idea, on target evidence.

NEXT UNTRIED HYPOTHESIS for the next lane, and it is now a CONJUNCTION OF THREE, which is why nothing has moved: the switch must be live (it is correct and free of debt), the fold must break, and the site-two zero web must merge. The switch is proven; probing the other two SEPARATELY will keep reading as neutral-or-worse exactly as it has for two runs, because the switch's +1 masks any single -1. The cheapest honest next step is to re-run the fold axes WITH THE SWITCH LIVE, since alignment-sensitivity is a recorded property of this project and every fold probe to date was measured against the mis-shaped branch region.
